verdict.rationale: Bland's docs describe a built-in Knowledge feature that lets an agent answer callers from the documents you provide rather than from its prompt, which is the core of this story. The support rests on a single summary-level doc excerpt with no detail on how grounding works. Missing for 10: details on supported document types and ingestion (upload/API), retrieval or RAG configuration and limits, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can ground the agent on my documents with a built-in knowledge base or RAG so it answers from my content

citations.quote: Knowledge is how an agent answers from your content rather than from its prompt.
the agent reads the answer out of the documents you gave it.
